high_level_overview.overview: COSGN00C is the entry point for the CardDemo application, a credit card management system running on IBM mainframe under CICS. It serves as the security gateway that controls access to all downstream application functions, operating as the first screen users encounter when initiating the CC00 transaction. The program presents a signon screen to collect user credentials, validates them against a security file, and routes authenticated users to the appropriate menu based on their user type — either an administrative dashboard or a standard customer menu — effectively enforcing role-based access control for the entire application.

key_features.description: Presents a formatted BMS signon screen with application title, current date/time, system ID, and input fields for User ID and Password.
Reads the USRSEC security file to verify the entered User ID exists and that the provided password matches the stored value.
After successful authentication, transfers control to the admin program (COADM01C) for admin users or the standard menu program (COMEN01C) for regular users.
Checks that both User ID and Password fields are populated before attempting file lookup, prompting the user with specific messages if either is missing.
Handles distinct error scenarios including wrong password, user not found (RESP code 13), and general file access failures, each with a descriptive message returned to the screen.
Populates the shared CARDDEMO-COMMAREA with user ID, user type, originating transaction, and program context to support downstream program communication.
Allows users to exit the application gracefully by pressing PF3, displaying a thank-you message and returning without further processing.
Returns control to the CC00 transaction with the COMMAREA after each interaction, maintaining conversational state across screen interactions.

input_output.name: USRSEC
input_output.description: User security file - reads user credentials (password and user type) to authenticate the user during signon. Keyed by User ID.

data_flow.description: Program starts, clears error flag and message fields. Checks EIBCALEN to determine if this is a fresh invocation or a return from a previous transaction.
If EIBCALEN is zero (first invocation), clears the output map, sets cursor to User ID field, and sends the signon screen to the terminal.

On subsequent invocations, evaluates the EIBAID to determine user action: Enter key triggers credential processing, PF3 sends a thank-you message and exits, any other key sets error flag and redisplays the screen.
On Enter key press, receives the BMS map COSGN0A from mapset COSGN00, capturing user-entered User ID and Password fields from the terminal.
Validates that both User ID and Password fields are non-blank and non-low-values. Sets error flag and redisplays screen with appropriate message if either field is empty.
Converts User ID and Password to uppercase using FUNCTION UPPER-CASE. Stores normalized User ID into both WS-USER-ID and CDEMO-USER-ID in the shared commarea.
Reads the USRSEC file using WS-USER-ID as the key to retrieve the stored user security record containing password and user type.
Compares the stored password (SEC-USR-PWD) from the security file against the entered password (WS-USER-PWD). On mismatch, sets error message and redisplays screen.
If CICS READ returns response code 13 (NOTFND), sets error flag and displays 'User not found' message, repositioning cursor to User ID field.
On successful authentication, populates the shared CARDDEMO-COMMAREA with transaction ID, program name, user ID, user type, and resets program context to zero.
Transfers control to COADM01C for admin users or COMEN01C for regular users via CICS XCTL, passing the populated CARDDEMO-COMMAREA.
Populates screen header fields including application titles, transaction name, program name, current date/time, APPLID, and SYSID before sending the signon screen.
Returns control to CICS with transaction ID CC00 and the CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, ensuring state is preserved for the next interaction cycle.

data_dependencies.description: The entire flow branches on EIBCALEN being zero or non-zero. A zero value forces a fresh screen display regardless of any other state, making this the primary entry-point discriminator.
WS-ERR-FLG must be 'N' (ERR-FLG-OFF) for READ-USER-SEC-FILE to be invoked. Any validation failure in PROCESS-ENTER-KEY sets it to 'Y', short-circuiting the file read and preventing unnecessary I/O.
User ID is validated before Password. If User ID is blank, the program redisplays the screen without ever checking the Password field, establishing a strict left-to-right validation dependency.

Successful authentication depends entirely on the existence and correctness of the user record in the USRSEC VSAM file. The program cannot authenticate if the file is unavailable or the record is missing (RESP 13).

Both the entered password (WS-USER-PWD) and the stored password (SEC-USR-PWD) must be in the same case for comparison to succeed. The entered password is uppercased, implying the stored password must also be uppercase for correct matching.

CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, CDEMO-USER-ID, CDEMO-USER-TYPE, and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT must all be set before XCTL is issued. The receiving programs (COADM01C, COMEN01C) depend on this commarea being fully populated.

The value of SEC-USR-TYPE read from the USRSEC file is moved to CDEMO-USER-TYPE and evaluated via CDEMO-USRTYP-ADMIN condition. The routing to admin vs. regular menu is entirely dependent on this field's value.

data_dependencies.dependency: BMS Map Receive Before Field Access
data_dependencies.description: USERIDI and PASSWDI fields in COSGN0AI are only valid after the CICS RECEIVE MAP command completes successfully. Any access to these fields before the receive would yield unpredictable data.

data_dependencies.dependency: CICS ASSIGN for APPLID and SYSID
data_dependencies.description: APPLIDO and SYSIDO in the output map are populated via CICS ASSIGN commands during header population. These values are runtime-dependent and cannot be statically defined, creating a dependency on the CICS system environment.

external_system_integrations.purpose: Sends and receives the COSGN0A signon screen map (mapset COSGN00) to/from the 3270 terminal, handling field-level cursor positioning and screen erasure.
Performs keyed READ operations against the USRSEC dataset to retrieve user security records (password and user type) for authentication.
Transfers control to COADM01C (admin menu) or COMEN01C (regular user menu) after successful authentication, passing the populated CARDDEMO-COMMAREA.
Retrieves runtime system values APPLID and SYSID from the CICS environment for display in the screen header.
Returns control to CICS specifying transaction ID CC00 and commarea, enabling pseudo-conversational transaction cycling and state preservation between user interactions.

called_programs.name: COADM01C.cbl
called_programs.purpose: COADM01C is part of the CardDemo application, a credit card management system that provides administrative functions for managing card accounts and users. This program serves as the administrative navigation hub, presenting a menu of administrative options exclusively to admin-level users within the CICS online transaction environment. The program displays a dynamic menu of up to 10 administrative options, captures the user's selection, validates it, and transfers control to the appropriate administrative sub-program, acting as the central dispatcher for all admin workflows in the CardDemo system.

error_handling.description: Validates User ID and Password fields for blank or low-value input before processing. Sets WS-ERR-FLG to 'Y', populates WS-MESSAGE with a descriptive prompt (e.g., 'Please enter User ID ...'), positions the cursor on the offending field using USERIDL/PASSWDL set to -1, and redisplays the signon screen via SEND-SIGNON-SCREEN. Subsequent processing is gated by checking ERR-FLG-ON to prevent further execution when validation fails.

Handles unexpected attention identifier keys (anything other than ENTER or PF3) in the EVALUATE EIBAID block. Sets WS-ERR-FLG to 'Y', moves the predefined CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY message to WS-MESSAGE, and redisplays the signon screen to inform the user of the unsupported key press.

After a successful file read (RESP code 0), compares SEC-USR-PWD against WS-USER-PWD. On mismatch, sets WS-MESSAGE to 'Wrong Password. Try again ...', positions the cursor on the password field (PASSWDL = -1), and redisplays the signon screen. No error flag is set for wrong password, distinguishing it from system-level errors.

error_handling.category: File Operation Errors - Record Not Found
error_handling.description: Checks CICS READ RESP code for value 13 (NOTFND condition). Sets WS-ERR-FLG to 'Y', moves 'User not found. Try again ...' to WS-MESSAGE, positions the cursor on the User ID field (USERIDL = -1), and redisplays the signon screen to prompt re-entry of credentials.

Handles all non-zero, non-13 RESP codes from the CICS READ via the WHEN OTHER clause. Sets WS-ERR-FLG to 'Y', moves 'Unable to verify the User ...' to WS-MESSAGE, positions the cursor on the User ID field (USERIDL = -1), and redisplays the signon screen. Raw RESP and RESP2 codes are captured in WS-RESP-CD and WS-REAS-CD but are not surfaced directly to the user.

Detects a fresh session by checking EIBCALEN = 0. Initializes the screen map to LOW-VALUES, positions the cursor on the User ID field (USERIDL = -1), and sends the signon screen. This prevents processing stale or uninitialized COMMAREA data and ensures a clean starting state.

overview.business_function: Provides the signon/login screen for the CardDemo mainframe application. Users enter their User ID and Password to authenticate. Upon successful authentication, admin users are transferred to the admin menu (COADM01C) and regular users to the main menu (COMEN01C). The screen includes decorative ASCII art styled as a currency note representing the fictional 'United States of KICSLAND'.

pf_keys.action: Submit User ID and Password for authentication. Validates credentials against the USRSEC file. On success, transfers admin users to COADM01C (Admin Menu) or regular users to COMEN01C (Main Menu). Displays error messages for blank User ID, blank Password, wrong password, or user not found.
Exit the application. Displays a 'Thank You' message and returns without transferring to another program.
